title.narrative: Harnessing Science-Policy Nexus for Advancing Anticipatory Governance and Strengthening Foresight and Futures Literacy in Eastern Africa

description.narrative: Grounded in UNESCO’s MOST Programme, this workplan will capitalize on work started last biennium to strengthen the critical link between social science research and public policy and equip key institutions in Member State with the capacities needed to generate and apply evidence in decision-making processes. Three strategic interventions will be considered: 1. Institutionalizing Futures Literacy and Legislative Foresight for Oversight and Accountability, focusing on embedding foresight and futures literacy within public service systems. 2. Leveraging Philosophy and World Philosophy Day to Address Complex Policy Challenges. 3. Advancing the General History of Africa and UNITWIN Network for Policy-Relevant Knowledge and Reparative Justice.
